clue.text: Weapon protecting good ornamental tableware

parts.note: a cutlass is a short curved sword

explanation.surface: A sword-wielder stands guard over fine decorative dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Cut glass is decorated glassware with facets ground into it, used for bowls, decanters and similar display pieces.

clue.text: Expels from burrow as hunter ordered

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'organ and' looks like part of the instrument list, but those words are the shuffled letters, leaving 'other instrument' as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand piano is a large horizontal-stringed keyboard instrument, a different instrument from an organ.

clue.text: American's brief advice for young man on new garment

explanation.walkthrough: 'American's' points to the US frontier slogan 'Go west, young man'; shortened, west becomes W.
explanation.definitionFit: A gown is a long dress or robe, an item of clothing.

clue.text: Crowning touch I added in big game

indicators.note: a letter added in is placed within the word

parts.note: a final is the deciding match of a competition, the biggest game

explanation.definitionFit: A finial is an ornament crowning the top of a roof, spire or post.

parts.note: enmity is hostility or opposition

clue.text: Farming expert finding nothing in most grain wrong

taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: One quickly delivers power cable specially ordered

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a courier; in cricket a bowler delivers the ball, and a pace bowler bowls fast.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a pace bowler is a fast bowler, whose deliveries arrive at high speed.

clue.text: Something big that gets blanket coverage in newspaper

definitions.text: Something big that gets blanket coverage

clue.text: Most important decade in Western thought, ultimately

clue.text: In Michaelmas, say, educationally evaluated

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

clue.text: Dream part, one in a thousand, happening

I is the Roman numeral one
something on is taking place, happening

explanation.surface: Part of a dream turns out to be a one-in-a-thousand event.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambition is a hope or aspiration, a dream of what one wants to achieve.

clue.text: Brazilian leader and woman in neighbouring country

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: Olivia is a woman's name

clue.text: Gather round port, not vintage

clue.text: Run and catch up teammate

clue.text: Joining live action in court earlier

clue.text: Celebrated university in fine old book

clue.text: Remove head of one handle or another

parts.note: a shaft is the long handle of a tool such as an axe or spear

clue.text: On paper, charming female that'll get something started on schedule

clue.text: Achieve victory with key attacker on side

clue.text: One's not batted without trepidation as English yield in collapse

parts.note: taken as written
